summary: Verified the two guest Free Trial session flow fixes in GuestSessionPage.jsx. (1) Quiz results now persist: after submitting the 5-question quiz on session 18bfb490 (document), the quiz-result screen with score % + per-question breakdown stays visible and no longer auto-jumps to the Simulation tab; the new 'Continue to Simulation' button (data-testid='quiz-continue-btn') is present and correctly advances to sim phase. (2) Sim renderer mapping fixed: session 18bfb490 (document type) now renders the real DocumentSim showing 'HDFC Bank Limited' balance sheet + a 'YOUR TASKS' panel with 5 interactive tasks (Task 1 of 5, number input, Submit) — no more 'No chapters authored yet' fallback. Session b5b21761 (excel type) renders the real ExcelSim/Univer interactive spreadsheet (3 canvas elements, univer container present, Quarter/Revenue/Tax Rate data grid) — no longer just plain text hints. (3) Simulation Complete screen (data-testid='sim-result') stays visible with 'Continue' button (data-testid='sim-continue-btn'); clicking Continue correctly navigates from session 1 → session 2 (b5b21761). (4) Regression: Video and Notes tabs still auto-advance immediately after completion — no manual continue on those phases. All flows work as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: GuestSessionPage.jsx is now ~700 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting phase components (VideoPhase, NotesPhase, QuizPhase, SimPhase, PaywallCTA) into their own files under components/guest/ for maintainability.
Line 580: doneCount computation uses a no-op `+ (done.includes(sessionId) ? 0 : 0)` — dead code, remove.

Backend /api/free-session/* endpoints return 403 without a guest fingerprint header (verified via plain curl). This is expected/by-design, but a note-worthy detail for future backend regression scripts — they must send the guest fingerprint header used by guestFetch().
seed_data_creation: None — used existing two free sessions (18bfb490 document, b5b21761 excel). Preset guest progress in localStorage keys vv_guest_sess_<id> and vv_guest_done to skip past earlier phases during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct localStorage keys used by GuestSessionPage.jsx are `vv_guest_sess_<sessionId>` (per-session progress object with fields videoWatched, notesComplete, quizComplete, quizScore, simComplete) and `vv_guest_done` (JSON array of completed session ids). Note: the problem statement referenced older key names `vv_free_session_progress`/`vv_free_done_ids` which are NOT what the code actually uses. To skip to sim phase for testing: set vv_guest_sess_<id> with videoWatched=true, notesComplete=true, quizComplete=true. To trigger the sim-result 'Simulation Complete' screen without playing the sim, additionally set simComplete=true then click phase-tab-sim. Two free sessions: 18bfb490-269b-444a-935f-df2508304a71 (document, no video), b5b21761-5aab-4b07-ac46-baeddea842dd (excel with Univer spreadsheet — allow ~10s for bundle to load).
rca of the issue: Original bug was two-fold in GuestSessionPage.jsx: (a) SimPhase mapped sim_type='document' to BookSim which expects a 'chapters' shape but the seeded free session uses DocumentSim's 'hints+tasks' shape — resulted in 'No chapters authored yet' fallback. Fixed by mirroring SimulationPage.jsx's exact sim_type→component mapping (excel→ExcelSim, document+format=book→BookSim, document→DocumentSim, decision_making/generic→DecisionMakingSim, book→BookSim, interactive→InteractiveSim, else→GenericRenderer). (b) handlePhaseComplete for quiz and sim used to call advancePhase() synchronously in the same call, so the QuizPhase's 'submitted' state and SimPhase's isDone-driven completion screen were only rendered for a single frame before being unmounted by the tab switch. Fixed by removing auto-advance for quiz/sim in handlePhaseComplete (video/notes still auto-advance since they have no results screen), and adding explicit 'Continue' buttons (quiz-continue-btn, sim-continue-btn) that call advancePhase manually via the onAdvance prop. Both fixes verified visually and via data-testid assertions.
